shortDescription: Configures security hardening rules and firewall

options.name: file
options.description: Specifies the security rules file to be applied. Mutually exclusive with I(level).

options.name: firewall
options.description: Specifies the firewall state and rules.

options.name: level
options.description: Specifies the security level settings to choose. Specifying C(high) security level might cause stability or serviceability issues especially in a cluster environment. Mutually exclusive with I(file).

options.name: rule
options.description: Specifies the name of the rule to be applied.
